entities.name: Table T5 – Automotive Industry Q2:25 YoY production growth by region and segment

entities.description: Shows comparative YoY growth rates for cars and trucks across regions in Q2 2025

properties.table_content:
| Region | Segment | YoY Production Growth |
|---|---|---|
| North America | Car | -11.2% |
| North America | Trucks | -2.5% |
| Europe | Car | 9.4% |
| Europe | Trucks | 8.0% |
| China | Car | -10.3% |
| China | Trucks | 0.3% |
| Global | Car | -1.7% |
| Global | Trucks | 3.2% |
properties.key_insight: Globally, truck production grew by 3.2% while car production declined by 1.7% in Q2 2025
